statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has documented supraventricular tachycardia
The patient is reporting recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient is reporting brief neurological deficits
Diagnosis codes G45.9 and I47.1 were submitted
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
Ambulatory cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
